coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up with the light on, checking written reminders and the shift roster note beside the bed
Showering, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the university day
Making tea with the kettle, eating a flexitarian breakfast of porridge and toast, and packing a packed lunch
Packing the study bag, checking the written to-do list and confirming the train and bus timetable on the phone
Commuting by train and bus to Monash University Clayton campus
Attending Master of Social Work lectures and tutorials on campus and taking detailed written notes
Eating a packed lunch on campus while reviewing lecture notes
Attending afternoon classes and completing group coursework and library study for the social work degree
Commuting home by bus and train from Clayton
Cooking and eating a flexitarian dinner and brewing a pot of tea
Washing the dishes, wiping the benches and putting away leftovers for the next day
Reviewing the weekly budget with cash envelopes and checking written reminders for rent, bills and upcoming shifts
Studying at the desk with the computer and desk lamp, writing a social work assignment
Making a cup of tea and having a light snack
Washing up and getting ready for bed
Quiet wind-down, looking at the photo of the family dog, and setting alarms and reminders for the next day
